name: serialdash
description: SerialDash monorepo: PWA serial monitor/dashboard, protocol, Arduino library, docs

scripts.gen: npm run gen -w tools/gen-types && npm run gen -w tools/gen-docs
scripts.gen:check: npm run gen && git diff --exit-code -- app/src/protocol/generated docs/protocol/messages.md docs/widgets
scripts.test: npm run test -w tools/validate-vectors && npm run test -w app
